PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 23, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54120  Recommendation to approve the January 9, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-54121  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-25-219 and authorize the General
  Manager to execute an agreement, and any necessary amendments with Ferguson
  Enterprises LLC., to furnish and deliver miscellaneous water works materials and
  bronze products in an annual amount not to exceed $715,000 for a period of one
  (1) year, and authorize the General Manager to exercise the option to renew for two
  additional one-year periods, subject to a maximum annual increase of 7.5 percent.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-54122  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute an agreement, and
  any necessary documents and subsequent amendments, with Woodard & Curran,
  Inc., a Maine corporation, to provide professional consulting services to develop a
  2025 Water Resources Plan, in an amount not to exceed $674,245.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-54124  Receive verbal presentation – Water Supply Update.

  Suggested Action:  Receive verbal report.

 5.  25-54125  Receive and file Board Agenda Planning Report: Business Plan, Retreat, Budget
  and Rates.

  Suggested Action:  Receive and file.

 PUBLIC COMMENT
